title: nlwf-2009-world-heavyweight
label: Tails

won.source: Its champions page lists Tails as first World champion, 'awarded title', one day, at Tournament to the Title; on the card itself Ramirez Silva tells the tournament winner Cyber Punk he is only the number one contender, says 'the title holder is this man', and Tails walks out holding the belt.

how: Named the title holder by Ramirez Silva at the end of Tournament to the Title, walking out with the belt; the champions page gives his reign as one day.

title: nlwf-2009-world-heavyweight
label: Cyber Punk

won.source: Its champions page lists Cyber Punk as 'Awarded Title' on 02/1/09; the Tournament to the Title page itself ends with Tails holding the belt, and Direct Hit 3 (7 February) bills Cyber Punk as 'your NLWF World Heavyweight Wrestling Champion', so the award fell between the two pages.

how: Awarded the title after winning the Tournament to the Title (the award itself is not on the recovered pages); kept it against Cipher on Direct Hit 3 (by disqualification) and Havoc at New Era; lost it to Joe Santiago at War Games.

title: nlwf-2009-world-heavyweight
label: Joe Santiago

won.source: War Games: 'the winner of the match, Joe Santiago' after the I Think He's Dead; its champions page records the change.

how: Pinned Cyber Punk at War Games; kept the title against Cyber Punk on Direct Hit 8; walked out of King of the Throne instead of defending it.

title: nlwf-2009-world-heavyweight
label: Brenton Cyrus

won.source: King of the Throne: Brenton Cyrus escapes the cage with the belt; the Direct Hit pages thereafter call him World Heavyweight Champion.

how: Won the first King of the Throne match; defended against Skye Chamberlain (Direct Hit 11, 2 May), Mexican Samurai (Guilty as Charged), Conor O'Sullivan (Legacy 11) and five challengers in the Steel Asylum at Simple Survival, the last recovered 2009 page. The one-year show of 18 January 2010 bills The Notorious K.I.D as 'Heavyweight and Undisputed Champion', so the reign ended at a date and in a way the recovered pages do not give.

title: nlwf-2009-universal
label: Havoc

won.source: Its champions page: Havoc 'won battle royal' at Legacy on 03/07/09; Legacy 1 (8 March 2009 on its archive list) is not among the recovered pages, but Legacy 2 calls him Universal champion.

how: Listed as winning a battle royal on Legacy; billed Universal Champion on Legacy 2.

title: nlwf-2009-universal
label: Shayne Wolf

won.source: War Games: the Steel Asylum triple threat; the referee awards the belt to Shayne Wolf.

how: Won the Steel Asylum at War Games, called by Legacy 3 'Universal Champion Shayne Wolf'; lost it to Havoc on Legacy 3.

title: nlwf-2009-universal
label: Havoc

won.source: Legacy 3: Havoc tombstones Shayne Wolf and is called 'newly re-attained' Universal Champion.

how: Regained the title from Shayne Wolf on Legacy 3; lost it to The Mexican Samurai at a house show shortly before Legacy 4.

title: nlwf-2009-universal
label: The Mexican Samurai

won.source: Legacy 4 presents The Mexican Samurai as the new Universal Champion after beating Havoc at a house show; its champions page dates his reign 04/19/09.

how: Won the title from Havoc at a house show; Havoc claimed he was still champion, and the pages then unify the two belts into the Undisputed Universal Championship in The Mexican Samurai's favor; lost it when Tails cashed in the Championship Case at King of the Throne.

title: nlwf-2009-universal
label: Tails

won.source: King of the Throne: John Griffyn announces 'the new Undisputed Universal Champion, the Epic Messiah, Tails'.

how: Unmasked from a Jason mask after Ramirez Silva blew up the cell, cashed in the Championship Case and pinned The Mexican Samurai, Havoc (as Dwayne Hurst) and Johnny Styles in turn with Silva counting; lost the title to Cyber Punk on Direct Hit 12.

title: nlwf-2009-universal
label: Cyber Punk

won.source: Direct Hit 12: 'the new Undisputed Universal Champion, Cyber Punk'; Legacy 7 next day calls him Legacy's Undisputed Universal Champion.

how: Beat Tails with the Cyber Death Driver on Direct Hit 12; lost it to Kaos in a first blood match at Guilty as Charged.

title: nlwf-2009-universal
label: Kaos

won.source: Guilty as Charged: 'the new Universal Champion, Kaos'.

how: Won a first blood match from Cyber Punk with a razor-bladed boot; kept it against Demetrius Randall and Cyber Punk; eliminated by Demetrius Randall on Simple Survival.

title: nlwf-2009-universal
label: Frank Hart

won.source: Simple Survival: the draw 'un-unified' the Undisputed Universal Championship and Marissa Johnson names Frank Hart and Demetrius Randall 'both, NEW Universal Heavyweight Champions'; its champions page lists Frank Hart as Direct Hit's Universal champion.

how: One of the two champions named after the draw in the Universal Championship final at Simple Survival, as Direct Hit's champion.

title: nlwf-2009-universal-legacy
label: Demetrius Randall

won.source: Simple Survival: named one of two new Universal Heavyweight Champions; its champions page lists him as Legacy's Universal champion.

how: One of the two champions named after the draw in the Universal Championship final at Simple Survival, as Legacy's champion.

title: nlwf-2009-north-american
label: Jackson

won.source: Tournament to the Title: 'the NLWF North American Champion, Jackson' after a match for the first title.

how: Won the first North American title in a match against Keith Cunningham at Tournament to the Title, breaking his own forearm along the way; lost it in the Best of Seven Series.

title: nlwf-2009-north-american
label: Keith Cunningham

won.source: Direct Hit 5: Ramirez Silva ends the Best of Seven Series after Keith Cunningham leads two matches to one and names him 'the new North American Champion'.

how: Awarded the title after the Best of Seven Series; lost it to The Mexican Samurai in an MMA-rules match at War Games.

title: nlwf-2009-north-american
label: The Mexican Samurai

won.source: War Games: The Mexican Samurai makes Keith Cunningham go limp in an armbar; its champions page records the change.

how: Won the title from Keith Cunningham at War Games; lost it in a three-way on Legacy 4.

title: nlwf-2009-north-american
label: Frank Hart

won.source: Legacy 4: Frank Hart pins The Mexican Samurai with the Cardiac Arrest in a three-way with Peter Kaymakcian.

how: Won a three-way on Legacy 4; lost it to Alex Mark in the unification match on Direct Hit 12.

title: nlwf-2009-north-american
label: Alex Mark

won.source: Direct Hit 12: 'the first ever Undisputed' North American Champion after beating Frank Hart in the unification match; its champions page records it.

how: As Junior Heavyweight Champion, beat Frank Hart in a unification match, absorbing the Junior Heavyweight title; lost the Undisputed North American title to Demetrius Randall in a Hangman Horrors match at Guilty as Charged.

title: nlwf-2009-north-american
label: Demetrius Randall

won.source: Guilty as Charged: 'new North American Champion, Demetrius Randall'.

how: Won a Hangman Horrors match from Alex Mark; kept it against Tyler Lucas and Cain Alexander (Direct Hit 15) and Joe Santiago by forfeit; lost it to Frank Hart on Simple Survival.

title: nlwf-2009-north-american
label: Frank Hart

won.source: Simple Survival: 'NEW North American Champion, Frank Hart'.

how: Won the title from Demetrius Randall at Simple Survival.

title: nlwf-2009-junior-heavyweight
label: Brenton Cyrus

won.source: New Era: 'the first ever Junior Heavyweight Champion, Brenton Cyrus' after the four-way.

how: Won the four-way for the first Junior Heavyweight title; lost it by disqualification to Johnny Electric on Direct Hit 7.

title: nlwf-2009-junior-heavyweight
label: Johnny Electric

won.source: Direct Hit 7: Marissa Johnson announces 'new Jr Heavyweight Champion, Johnny Electric' and Carmine Vestieri rules the title can change on a disqualification.

how: Won the title by disqualification from Brenton Cyrus; lost it in a three-way at War Games.

title: nlwf-2009-junior-heavyweight
label: Tapido Delevega

won.source: War Games: Tapido Delevega pins Bobby Ocean with the Seville Thrill and is called the new Junior Heavyweight Champion on Direct Hit 8.

how: Won a three-way at War Games; defended against Master of Disaster on Direct Hit 10; lost it to Alex Mark at King of the Throne.

title: nlwf-2009-junior-heavyweight
label: Alex Mark

won.source: King of the Throne: Alex Mark wins the electrified barbed-wire match and is announced Junior Heavyweight Champion on Direct Hit 11.

how: Won the title from Tapido Delevega at King of the Throne; kept it against Anthony Bennett on Direct Hit 11; put it up in the unification match on Direct Hit 12.

title: nlwf-2009-no-limit
label: Death Angel

won.source: Its champions page: Death Angel awarded the title on Direct Hit 03/10/09; Direct Hit 7 (14 March) calls him 'No Limit Champion Death Angel'.

how: Awarded the title; forfeited it to Chuck Matthews at the Hall of Fame show for Johnny Styles.

title: nlwf-2009-no-limit
label: Chuck Matthews

won.source: Hall of Fame show for Johnny Styles: Ramirez Silva announces that Death Angel must forfeit the No Limit title to Chuck Matthews; its champions page dates the start 02/23/09, which the shows contradict.

how: Took the title in the trade with the West; kept it against Jake Stunner (Direct Hit 8, by Carmine Vestieri's ruling), against Anthony Bennett and Chad Vargas at King of the Throne, and against Jake Stunner on Direct Hit 13; lost it to Frank Hart at the Hall of Fame show for Joe Santiago.

title: nlwf-2009-no-limit
label: Frank Hart

won.source: Hall of Fame show for Joe Santiago: 'new No Limit Champion, Frank Hart'.

how: Won the title from Chuck Matthews with the DVD Moment; kept it against Death Angel at Guilty as Charged; his champions page says he forfeited it; the date of the change to Swan Lee is not on the recovered pages.

title: nlwf-2009-no-limit
label: Swan Lee

won.source: Simple Survival calls Swan Lee 'the current No Limit Champion' and he beats Hazard to keep it; its champions page says Frank Hart forfeited and lists Swan Lee as champion.

how: Champion by Simple Survival, where he retained against Hazard.

title: nlwf-2009-world-tag-team
label: The Heart Attacks

won.source: Tournament to the Title: 'the new NLWF Tag Team Champions, The Heart Attacks'.

how: Beat the Straight Edge Gunners at Tournament to the Title; its champions page lists the titles awarded to Havoc and Death Angel the same day.

title: nlwf-2009-world-tag-team
label: The Asylum (Havoc and Death Angel)

won.source: Its champions page: Havoc and Death Angel 'awarded titles' on Direct Hit 02/01/09; the Asylum carries the gold on Direct Hit 3 and wins the Direct Hit 4 title match.

how: Awarded the titles; held them through February; the champions page then lists Havoc with Shadow Demon and the card of Legacy 4 names Havoc and Shayne Wolf as champions.

title: nlwf-2009-world-tag-team
label: The Mexican Samurai and Shadow Demon

won.source: Legacy 4: Shadow Demon pins Havoc with the Shadow Crusher; The Mexican Samurai holds the tag belt afterward; its champions page records the change.

how: Won the titles on Legacy 4; the date the reign ended is not on the recovered pages (the titles are unified on Direct Hit 12).

title: nlwf-2009-world-tag-team
label: Havoc and Shayne Wolf

won.source: Legacy 4 (11 April 2009) bills the match as for 'the NLWF World Tag Team Titles' and Havoc and Shayne Wolf are the champions.

how: Champions by Legacy 4; lost the titles to The Mexican Samurai and Shadow Demon there.

title: nlwf-2009-universal-tag-team
label: DX Affliction

won.source: Direct Hit 6: 'NEW Universal Tag Team Champions, DX Affliction'.

how: Beat One World Nation with The End Result on Direct Hit 6; Johnny Styles gave up his half to Jake Stunner on Direct Hit 8.

title: nlwf-2009-universal-tag-team
label: Joe Santiago and Jake Stunner

won.source: Direct Hit 8: Johnny Styles hands the tag title to Jake Stunner and announces 'Joe Santiago and Jake Stunner' as the new champions; its champions page calls it awarded.

how: Awarded the titles on Direct Hit 8; lost them in a ladder match on Direct Hit 9.

title: nlwf-2009-universal-tag-team
label: Brenton Cyrus and Chuck Matthews

won.source: Direct Hit 9: Salvation pulls both belts down in the ladder match.

how: Won a ladder match on Direct Hit 9; kept the titles against Tapido Delevega and Dark Tiger (Direct Hit 11) and, in the unification match on Direct Hit 12, absorbed the World Tag Team title as the Undisputed Tag Team Champions; Chuck Matthews traded his belt for the Freedom title after Cyrus was traded.

title: nlwf-2009-universal-tag-team
label: 25 to Life

won.source: Legacy 11 calls Brenton Cyrus and The Mexican Samurai, 25 to Life, the tag champions; its champions page says The Mexican Samurai replaced Chuck Matthews.

how: Champions by Legacy 11 after Cyrus's trade to Legacy; the date they took the belts is not on the recovered pages.

title: nlwf-2009-freedom
label: Chuck Matthews

won.source: Direct Hit 15: Carmine Vestieri hands Chuck Matthews the new belt in exchange for his IOU; its champions page dates it 06/13/09.

how: Given the new Freedom title in exchange for his Undisputed Tag Team share; lost it to Frank Hart on Direct Hit 16.

title: nlwf-2009-freedom
label: Frank Hart

won.source: Direct Hit 16: 'NEW NLWF Freedom Champion, Frank Hart'.

how: Won a Chuck's Law match; lost the title to Kaos in a ladder match at Simple Survival.

title: nlwf-2009-freedom
label: Kaos

won.source: Simple Survival: Kaos takes the belt down and Marissa Johnson names him 'NEW, Freedom Champion'.

how: Won the Freedom title at Simple Survival.

title: nlwf-2009-annihilation
label: Brenton Cyrus

won.source: Its champions page: Brenton Cyrus 'won tournament' at Annihilation on 04/17/09; Direct Hit 10 calls him 'the first Annihilation champion'. The Annihilation show itself is not among the recovered pages.

how: First champion, from the Annihilation tournament; lost the title to Death Angel in a cage match on Legacy 10, the day the champions page gives.

title: nlwf-2009-annihilation
label: Death Angel

won.source: Its champions page: Death Angel beats Brenton Cyrus on Legacy 06/14/09; Legacy 11 calls him 'the Global Annihilation Champion'.

how: Won the title in a cage match on Legacy 10 after Justin Kash pulled him out; kept it against Alex Mark on Legacy 11.

title: nlwf-2009-proving-grounds
label: Conor O'Sullivan

won.source: Its champions page: Conor O'Sullivan beat Tantrum at Proving Grounds, 04/25/09; the Proving Grounds show is not among the recovered pages.

how: First champion on its champions page, from the Proving Grounds show; lost it to Aaron O'Shea in a three-way on Legacy 7.

title: nlwf-2009-proving-grounds
label: Aaron O'Shea

won.source: Legacy 7: Aaron O'Shea pins Tantrum with the Dublin Domination in a three-way and is handed the title; its champions page dates it 05/09/09.

how: Won the Proving Grounds title from Conor O'Sullivan on Legacy 7; kept it against Tantrum and Outsider at Guilty as Charged; Direct Hit 14 says the title match was voided after his trade to Legacy, and he still carries it on Legacy 11.

title: nlwf-2009-womens-world
label: Tiffany Starr

won.source: Its champions page: Tiffany Starr beat Prescilla at Legacy 10 on 06/07/09; the Legacy 10 show is not among the recovered pages.

how: First champion on its champions page; kept it against Emily Brown on Legacy 11 and Simple Survival.

title: nlwf-2009-undisputed
label: The Notorious K.I.D

won.source: His own words on the one-year show: 'Last week I not only beat Steven to become the newest Undisputed Champion'; the show's weekly Monday cadence puts last week at 11 January.

how: Beat Steven Angel for the Undisputed title the week before the one-year show; lost it in the main-event street fight when Jason Hawk pinned him.

title: nlwf-2009-undisputed
label: Jason Hawk

won.source: The one-year show: 'HERE IS YOUR WINNER...AND NEW UNDISPUTED CHAMPION...JASON HAWK'.

how: Won the three-way street fight against Steven Angel and the champion The Notorious K.I.D by pinning him after a shooting star swanton.

title: nlwf-2009-undisputed
label: Steven Angel

won.source: The one-year show's champion K.I.D says he beat Steven Angel to become the newest Undisputed Champion, so Steven Angel held the title before him.

how: Held the Undisputed Championship before the week of 11 January 2010, when The Notorious K.I.D beat him for it (his own account).

title: nlwf-2009-tag-team
label: Ryan Apollo

won.source: The one-year show: 'since Nick and Chuck can't compete at this time...RYAN APOLLO is the NEW NLWF TAG TEAM CHAMPION!'

how: Declared champion by default on the one-year show; his billed partner Brenton Cyrus was not there, and the announcer names only Ryan Apollo.

title: nlwf-2009-tag-team
label: Nick Ridicule and Chuck Matthews

won.source: The one-year show bills 'Ridicule and Matthews' against 'Cyrus and Apollos', announcing 'one half of the tag-team champions, Nick Ridicule', and says Chuck Matthews is still missing.

how: Champions entering the one-year show; neither could compete (Nick Ridicule was in an ambulance after the New Dawn's attack and Chuck Matthews was missing) so the title went to Ryan Apollo.
